newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC beefs up Thailand branch capital.
newsitem.headline: HSBC beefs up Thailand branch capital.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Ltd unit Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp, said on Monday it had increased its capital funds at its Thailand branch to 2.5 billion baht from 2.0 billion baht, effective September 26.
The increase has been registered with the Bank of Thailand, the company said in a statement.

"Despite the current economic slowdown, Hongkong Bank remains committed to expanding the scope of its banking operations in Thailand, as has always been the case since we first opened for business in 1888," said Richard Cromwell, chief executive officer of Hongkong Bank in Thailand.
Hongkong Bank said the capital increase will immediately benefit corporate customers through increased flexibility in lending and foreign exchange transactions.
The Bank of Thailand restricts lending to a single customer to 25 percent of capital funds. Additionally, a bank's open foreign exchange exposure may not exceed 20 percent of its capital funds.
Hongkong Bank said it also operates a Bangkok International Banking Facility in Bangkok.
